dedupe_keys.name: nrc datasets us commercial reactors research reactors spent fuel storage and decommissioning sites

description: The NRC Datasets page of the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission offers a set of Excel tables, each with a data dictionary, describing the nuclear facilities it regulates. Tables listed include operating commercial nuclear power reactors, reactors under active construction or deferred, reactors undergoing decommissioning or permanently shut down, cancelled reactors, commercial licensing history from 1955 to 2020, new plant licensing applications, the advanced reactor integrated schedule, dry cask spent fuel storage licensees and approved designs, complex materials sites undergoing decommissioning, operating and decommissioning research and test reactors, import and export licences, and Native American reservations and trust lands within 50 miles of a nuclear power plant. Most tables were last updated on 23 February 2023, the licensing history in November 2021, and the page was last reviewed on 25 August 2026. Coverage is the United States. Files are free to download; as US government works they are in the public domain. Caveats: several tables have not been refreshed since 2023, so recent status changes are missing, and the tables hold attributes, not full geometry. Simulation uses are inventories of reactors and spent fuel sites for hazard exposure and emergency planning zone analysis. Related records: data-iaea-pris-power-reactor-information-system gives the worldwide reactor list.
